column1: Deprivation distribution by 8-point Pobal HP index for those aged 65 and over
column4: How adults aged 65 years and over are spread across different levels of social and economic disadvantage in an area, based on the Pobal HP Deprivation Index.  The Pobal HP Deprivation Index is Ireland's primary social gradient tool.  Based on the latest Census information (in this case Census 2022) it reveals the profile of communities across Ireland. The Pobal HP Deprivation Index uses data from Census 2022, analysing ten measures of an areas levels of disadvantage. These include educational attainment, employment status and the numbers living in individual households.

column25:
This KPI includes  referrals received from GPs within the month. For the purpose of this KPI this includes referrals received by GP's via Healthlink and other referral pathways - This KPI considers referrals accepted to ICPOP only.
This KPI includes referrals received from CHN  within the month. For the purpose of this KPI this includes referrals from members of the CHN multi-disciplinary clinical teams. A Community Healthcare Network (CHN) is defined as a network delivering primary healthcare services across a population of 50,000. It will consist of between 4-6 primary care teams. This KPI considers referrals accepted to ICPOP only.
This KPI includes referrals received from NAS and/or Pathfinder teams within the month. This KPI considers referrals accepted to ICPOP only.
This KPI includes referrals received from Frailty at the Front Door (or similar) service within the month. This KPI considers referrals accepted to ICPOP only.
This KPI includes referrals received from Geriatric Medicine teams within the month. This KPI considers referrals accepted to ICPOP only.
This KPI includes referrals received from ED broken down by the month. For example, an emergency medicine SHO, or staff member based in a Medical Assessment Unit (MAU) or  Geriatric Emergency Medicine Service (GEMS).This KPI considers referrals accepted to ICPOP only.
This KPI includes  referrals received from Acute Inpatient Floor within the month. For the purpose of this KPI this refers to referrals received from the Acute Floor for patients who had an acute inpatient stay. This KPI considers referrals accepted to ICPOP only.
This KPI includes  referrals received from Other Sources within the month. For the purpose of this KPI other sources includes ICPCD, Pyschiatry of Later Life, Community Nursing Units, Offsite Rehab, Short stay beds and other voluntary agencies etc. This KPI considers referrals accepted to ICPOP only.
This KPI includes new referrals accepted  to the ICPOP Community Specialist Team for older adults in Residential Care Facilities. For the purpose of this KPI this includes patients in Nursing Homes who reside there for Long term care.
